items.text: Attended my first **Dagstuhl Seminar** on *Technology, Trust, Truth: The Role of Responsible AI in Combating Misinformation*.
Presented Task 3 of the CheckThat! Lab at **CLEF 2026** in Jena, Germany.
Presented *Can LLMs Automate Fact-Checking Article Writing?* at **ACL 2026** in San Diego.
Released **Nanda 87B**, an open-weights Hindi-English bilingual LLM.
Back at MBZUAI after my visit to UKP Lab.
My first first-authored paper from my PhD, *Can LLMs Automate Fact-Checking Article Writing?*, was accepted at **TACL**.
The **CheckThat! Lab** was accepted at CLEF 2026, with a shared task on generating full fact-checking articles.
Joined the UKP Lab at TU Darmstadt as a visiting researcher.
Released **Nanda 10B**, an open-weights Hindi-English bilingual LLM.
Left Logically and started my PhD at MBZUAI.
Joined Logically as an NLP Engineer.
Graduated with a B.Tech in Computer Science and Applied Mathematics from IIIT-Delhi.
